# System Information
You are an expert in Java and in analyzing the impact of source code changes on other code entities in a project's production code.

# General Information
You receive information about a set of changes, called seed changes, that were made to fix a bug reported in Jira.
You also receive the Jira bug report title and description and an initial impact set consisting of the fully qualified names of code entities that are statically related to the seed changes.

# Task
Your task is to refine the initial impact set.
A code entity is part of the impact set if it requires modification or, if it does not already exist, must be created as a consequence of the seed changes.
First, remove code entities unless the provided information indicates that they must be modified.
Second, add code entities that must be modified or created according to the provided evidence.

Your goal is to report a final impact set that consists of the fully qualified names of code entities that must be modified or created because of the seed changes.

# Inputs
- Jira bug report title: OutOfMemoryError from CompressorStreamFactory
- Jira bug report description: While using Tika-1.14 to detect file types, the attached 1KB file triggered an OOME with 1GB heap. Tika calls CompressorStreamFactory.createCompressorInputStream(in) to detect if the file is a compressor stream, but CompressorStreamFactory erroneously detects it as a LZMACompressorInputStream and when the LZMACompressorInputStream is instanciated the OOME is thrown. This error does not happen with commons-compress versions prior to 1.10, when auto detecting LZMA streams was added. - Seed changes and their Git diff hunks: [{"fqn": "org.apache.commons.compress.compressors.CompressorStreamFactory.createCompressorInputStream(java.lang.String,java.io.InputStream,boolean)", "git_diff_hunk": "@@ -532 +508 @@ public CompressorInputStream createCompressorInputStream(final String name, fina\n- return new XZCompressorInputStream(in, actualDecompressConcatenated, memoryLimitInKb);\n+ return new XZCompressorInputStream(in, actualDecompressConcatenated);\n@@ -539 +515 @@ public CompressorInputStream createCompressorInputStream(final String name, fina\n- return new LZMACompressorInputStream(in, memoryLimitInKb);\n+ return new LZMACompressorInputStream(in);\n@@ -555 +531 @@ public CompressorInputStream createCompressorInputStream(final String name, fina\n- return new ZCompressorInputStream(in, memoryLimitInKb);\n+ return new ZCompressorInputStream(in);"}]
